test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following pair of "player - sports" is correct?

I. Lovlina Borgohain - Boxing

II. Nikhat Zareen - Wrestling
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only I**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lovlina Borgohain** is a well-known** Indian boxer.**

 
 
• She hails from Assam, India, and has represented **her country in many international tournaments, including the Olympics.**
 
• She has won numerous medals for her country in the field of boxing, which confirms the first part of the statement as true.
 
 
 
• **Nikhat Zareen**, on the other hand, is also an** Indian sportsperson, but she is not a wrestler**.
 
 
• **She, too, is involved in boxing, not wrestling.**
 
• She is a former Junior World Champion and has represented India in various boxing championships.
 
 
 
• The misconception might arise due to the fact that both** Lovlina Borgohain and Nikhat Zareen are involved in combat sports.**
 
• However, they are both boxers and not involved in wrestling.
 
• Hence, statement II**, "Nikhat Zareen - Wrestling", is not correct while statement I, "Lovlina Borgohain - Boxing", is correct.**
 
• **Thus, the correct answer is 4) Only I.**
